title: Locally $\aleph_0$-categorical theories and locally Roelcke precompact groups
summary: It is well-known that Polish Roelcke precompact groups are the groups that can be represented as automorphism groups of $\aleph_0$-categorical structures in continuous logic and that there is a precise correspondence between properties of the group and properties of the structure. The goal of this paper is to extend this correspondence to the classes of locally Roelcke precompact groups and locally $\aleph_0$-categorical structures, the latter of which we define here.
